messages:
anita: Heads-up — onboarding sample app is ambiguous about which env var to set for scoped API keys. docs mention REDWOOD_API_KEY in one place and RW_TOKEN in another. Which should we standardize on?

devex: +1 on unifying. proposal from my side: canonical is REDWOOD_API_KEY (this can be an org/project-scoped key or a short-lived token). fallback order should be explicit. Also we should deprecate RW_TOKEN but keep a compatibility window and emit a warning.

liam: fyi current SDK parity: python reads RW_TOKEN only, node reads REDWOOD_API_KEY, go SDK checks both but prefers file creds. That mismatch trips customers during onboarding.

anita: exactly the problem — sampleapp Dockerfile sets RW_TOKEN in CI but local dev guides show REDWOOD_API_KEY. New users hit 401s.

sarah: suggestion: add two small CLI helpers so users can quickly validate and rotate creds: `rw auth whoami` and `rw auth rotate --local|--ci`. Also document precedence and show example for CI. Example snippet we could add to docs: ```bash
# precedence
# 1. env: REDWOOD_API_KEY
# 2. env: RW_TOKEN (deprecated)
# 3. ~/.config/redwood/credentials
# 4. metadata server / instance role (for cloud infra)
```

devex: +1 on CLI helpers. For rotation we should recommend short-lived keys + a refreshable provider pattern (SDKs expose a token provider callback). That allows CI to exchange long-lived secret via KMS and get short tokens.

liam: I can open a cross-SDK PR to implement a consistent precedence and provider callback interface. Will need a tiny spec so each language can follow the same behavior.

infra-bot: Created issue <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/3421> "SDK env var parity + CLI whoami/rotate" and assigned to @liam and @sarah.

anita: thanks. one more UX note: sampleapp should print a clear error when the token is missing vs invalid (401). Right now it just shows generic "auth failed" which confuses non-technical PMs.

sarah: agreed. I'll update sampleapp to surface cause and a hint: "Set REDWOOD_API_KEY or run `rw auth login`". For private deployments we should add a KMS/HSM workflow doc for rotation.

devex: Action items: 1) liam: open SDK parity PR (env precedence + provider interface) — due EOD Thu. 2) sarah: update sampleapp and docs + add `rw auth whoami`/`rotate` examples — due next Tue. 3) devex: add deprecation note for RW_TOKEN and a migration checklist. I'll file the blog-style migration note.

anita: perfect. feel free to ping me for sampleapp testing. :thumbsup:

liam: will do, starting spec now.

infra-bot: Reminder: please link PRs to issue #3421 for tracking.
